workflow.name: Brand kit starter
workflow.description: From a business name and vibe, proposes 3 logo directions, renders a logo mark concept for each plus a moodboard with fal.ai FLUX (4 images), builds a color palette and writes brand-kit.md. Everything lands in Artifacts.

inputs.name: vibe
inputs.label: Vibe, audience and what you sell (e.g. calm, premium, eco-friendly skincare for busy parents)

inputs.name: avoid
inputs.label: Anything to avoid (colors, styles, competitors' looks) - optional

nodes.label: Propose 3 logo directions
nodes.prompt:
You are a brand designer. Propose exactly 3 distinct logo directions and one shared color palette for this business. Do not call any API and do not create files; output text only.

Business name: {{inputs.business}}
Vibe / audience / offer: {{inputs.vibe}}
Avoid: {{inputs.avoid}}

Output Markdown in exactly this structure:

## Direction 1: <short name>
- Idea: <one sentence: the concept and why it fits>
- Mark: <the symbol, shape language, line weight>
- Typography pairing: <wordmark font style, e.g. geometric sans, high-contrast serif>
- Image prompt: <one image-generation prompt, max 60 words, for a symbol-only logo mark: flat vector, centered on a plain white background, no text, no letters, no mockup, 1-2 colors from the palette named by hex>

(repeat for Direction 2 and Direction 3; make the three clearly different: e.g. abstract geometric, pictorial, monogram-inspired shape)

## Palette
A table with 5 rows: role (primary, secondary, accent, dark neutral, light neutral) | name | hex | usage. Check that text on the light neutral using the dark neutral is readable.

## Moodboard prompt
One image-generation prompt (max 90 words) for a single landscape moodboard collage: photography, textures, materials, typography samples and color swatches that capture the vibe, using the palette. No real brand logos, no recognizable people.

## Voice
Three adjectives for the brand voice and one example tagline.

nodes.label: Render logo marks and moodboard (fal, 4 images)
nodes.prompt:
Render the brand visuals with the fal.ai REST API (model fal-ai/flux/dev) and save them. Generate exactly 4 images in total, one request each, num_images 1. Do not retry more than once per image.

For each image: POST https://fal.run/fal-ai/flux/dev with headers `Authorization: Key $FAL_KEY` and `Content-Type: application/json`, body {"prompt": <prompt>, "image_size": <size>, "num_images": 1}. Use curl; read the key from the FAL_KEY environment variable, never print it or echo commands that expand it. Download images[0].url to the path below. If the response has no images[0].url, do not write a file for that image; note the error message from the response (never the key) and continue with the next image.

1. Direction 1 "Image prompt", image_size "square_hd" -> "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/logo-1.png"
2. Direction 2 "Image prompt", image_size "square_hd" -> "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/logo-2.png"
3. Direction 3 "Image prompt", image_size "square_hd" -> "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/logo-3.png"
4. "Moodboard prompt", image_size "landscape_16_9" -> "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/moodboard.png"

Also write the palette (no API call) as "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/palette.svg": a 1000x300 SVG with 5 equal color swatches from the Palette table, each labelled below with its role, name and hex in a readable color.

If FAL_KEY is not set, skip the 4 images, still write palette.svg, and say: add FAL_KEY in Hive › Keys.

Reply with: each saved path and the exact prompt used for it (or the error if one failed).

Directions:
{{directions.output}}

nodes.label: Write brand-kit.md and README
nodes.prompt:
Write two Markdown files. Do not call any image API.

1. "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/brand-kit.md": a concise brand kit for {{inputs.business}}. Sections: Overview (vibe in 2 sentences), Logo directions (for each of the 3: name, idea, typography pairing, and the image as ![](logo-N.png) if it was saved), Recommended direction (pick one and say why in 2-3 sentences), Color palette (the table, plus ![](palette.svg)), Moodboard (![](moodboard.png) if saved), Voice (adjectives + tagline), Next steps (3 bullets, e.g. refine the chosen mark in a vector tool, test at favicon size, check trademark availability). Note that AI logo concepts are starting points, not final trademark-ready artwork.

2. "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/README.md": a short list of every file this run saved in $ARTIFACTS_DIR (check with ls) with a one-line description each, then the exact prompts used for each image and the model (fal-ai/flux/dev).

Reply with the two paths and the recommended direction in one line.

Directions:
{{directions.output}}

Render results:
{{render.output}}
